'''Nate Hyde'''<ref name="dt-13717">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13717 Punk Ewoks], DeckTech (nate "deadbeat" hyde, 16 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13717/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13717/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018050246/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13717/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''deadbeat''') posted a [[Light]] [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]] list on DeckTech in February 2001.
